identity.name: Colada Shop - DMV menu-class record
identity.location: Six public-menu storefronts in Washington, DC and Northern Virginia
identity.notes: The frozen record intentionally mixed 14th & T and Wharf. Current first-party evidence resolves dc-metro as a six-store menu-class record: Café products apply only to Wharf/Dupont/Clarendon/National Landing and Cafecito products only to 14th/Mosaic. DCA is acknowledged by the brand but lacks a public menu class and live directory storefront, so no product is transferred to DCA.

sources.excerpt: Current official homepage identifies Colada Shop as a DC/Northern Virginia café group and advertises current seasonal food, coffee, zero-proof drinks, dietary options, and ordering.

Current official menu hub scopes the Café menu to Wharf, Dupont Circle, Clarendon, and National Landing; the smaller Cafecito menu to 14th St and Mosaic District; happy hour to the four Café stores; and links the current catering menu. Menus may vary seasonally or by location.
Official locations page identifies the Washington DC and Northern Virginia location set. Product scope is limited to the six storefronts assigned a public menu class; DCA is not assigned one.

Current two-page Café PDF, freshly rendered and visually reviewed in full. It provides the complete shared Café-class food and nonalcoholic catalog, direct ingredient descriptions, dietary symbols, and a gluten-friendly cross-contamination qualifier.
Current two-page Cafecito PDF, freshly rendered and visually reviewed in full. It provides the complete shared 14th St/Mosaic food and nonalcoholic catalog and the same gluten-friendly qualifier.
Current two-page happy-hour PDF, freshly rendered and visually reviewed in full. Only food and zero-proof products were inventoried; alcoholic cocktails, beer, and wine were excluded.

Current ten-page catering PDF, freshly rendered and visually reviewed in full. It publishes breakfast, sandwich, salad, buffet, platter, dessert, and nonalcoholic beverage presentations plus vegetarian, vegan, gluten-friendly, and contains-nuts legend terms.
The official-linked live Toast directory confirms six orderable storefronts: 14th & T, Clarendon, Dupont, Mosaic, National Landing, and Wharf, with exact addresses and store-specific ordering links.

Fresh live inspection of the 14th & T storefront inventoried every visible current food, nonalcoholic drink, and edible retail product, including current seasonal products and 14th-only frozen retail items; alcohol and merchandise were excluded.

Fresh live inspection of the Wharf storefront inventoried every visible current food, nonalcoholic drink, and edible retail product, including Wharf-only large plates and kids products; alcohol and merchandise were excluded.

A search-indexed Colada Shop Allergen Master List page from five months earlier now resolves live to the official site's 404 page. Its former downloadable document is not currently accessible and is not used as current evidence.

Fresh official-domain and broader targeted searches found the current menu PDFs and a cached retired allergen-page result, but no accessible current product-by-allergen matrix or current standalone allergen guide.

attempts.queryOrLocation: Official homepage, menu hub, locations page, and former /page/allergens-list route
attempts.notes: Current official pages provide dietary-positioning and menu-class scope, but the former allergen page now returns 404 and no current matrix is linked.

attempts.queryOrLocation: All four PDFs currently linked by the official menu hub, fully rendered and visually reviewed
attempts.notes: Documents provide ingredients, selected dietary labels, and a gluten-friendly cross-contamination qualifier, but no complete product-by-allergen matrix.

attempts.queryOrLocation: Official-linked live Toast directory plus complete live 14th & T and Wharf catalogs
attempts.notes: Live vendor pages provide product descriptions and exact store scope but no allergen matrix or product-level may-contain guide.

attempts.queryOrLocation: Official-domain and exact-brand searches for allergen, allergy, nutrition, ingredients, PDF, and menu
attempts.notes: Only a cached result for the now-404 former allergen page appeared; no accessible current matrix was found.

matrixSearch.notes: All four mandatory search classes are complete. Empty product arrays mean current direct evidence is unavailable, not allergen-free. Direct positives are limited to allergens explicitly named by current restaurant-issued or linked-vendor ingredients.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.scope: Products marked GF on the current Café and Cafecito PDFs
restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.notes: The menu legend defines GF as gluten-friendly with cross contamination possible. This is preserved as scoped restaurant-level evidence and is not converted into blanket product mayContain values.

dispositions.notes: Current official naming is Pineapple & Carrot Muffin; the prior Pride pastelito is the current Sweet Cream Cheese Pastelito presentation.
Winter Blend Coffee and Copa Snack Tray are absent from all current exact-scope surfaces.

Café and Soup & Salads are headings; L'Enfant Plaza is navigation text; Cigar City and Tropical Mimosa are alcohol; Colada Mug and Tumbler are merchandise. None belongs in the food/nonalcoholic product catalog.

reconciliation.notes: All 110 frozen rows are represented exactly once. Location-exclusive products remain current only on their supported Café, Cafecito, 14th, Wharf, happy-hour, or catering surfaces.

findings.summary: The record is a DMV menu-class union, not a single-location menu: four Café stores and two Cafecitos have distinct official scopes.
The formerly indexed allergen master-list page is now 404. Current official PDFs provide ingredients and scoped gluten-friendly guidance but not a complete allergen matrix.

The baseline mixed location-exclusive, seasonal, retail, alcohol, merchandise, and page-artifact rows. Current union inventory adds the complete Café, Cafecito, happy-hour, catering, and live edible-retail surfaces without transferring exclusive products between stores.

Current descriptions for both Havana Blend coffee bags describe coffee flavor notes and say it may be enjoyed with or without milk; they do not support baseline direct milk positives. Current direct-allergen arrays are therefore unavailable, not milk-positive.

routingSignals: Confirmed menu-class scope across six DMV storefronts
Current allergen matrix unavailable after all four searches
Large catalog drift with category, navigation, alcohol, and merchandise artifacts
Direct coffee-bag milk claims are unsupported by current descriptions
proposedChanges: Replace the mixed 110-row baseline with the scoped union of current Café, Cafecito, happy-hour, catering, and live edible-retail products.
Persist locationScope on every surface so Café-only, Cafecito-only, 14th-only, Wharf-only, and catering-only products are not flattened across the chain.
Remove alcohol, merchandise, category/navigation artifacts, and two stale seasonal retail rows from the product catalog.
Retain only current direct ingredient positives; store the GF cross-contamination legend as scoped restaurant-level evidence and treat all other absent allergen fields as unavailable.
